name: 2g-3g-4g-qos-network-intelligence
description: 2G/3G/4G QoS Network Intelligence - portable telecom QoS analytics workstation (Electron + DuckDB)
author: 2G/3G/4G QoS Network Intelligence

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --composite false && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json --composite false
scripts.smoke: node scripts/clean-smoke-temp.cjs && electron-vite build && mkdir -p /tmp/qos-runtime && XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp/qos-runtime XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/qos-runtime XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/qos-runtime WAYLAND_DISPLAY= DISPLAY= electron . --smoke --no-sandbox --ozone-platform=headless --headless
scripts.verify:packaged: node scripts/clean-smoke-temp.cjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux dir --config.directories.output=release-check --config.npmRebuild=false && node scripts/smoke-packaged.cjs release-check/linux-unpacked
scripts.dist: node scripts/ensure-duckdb-bindings.cjs && node scripts/clean-build-headroom.cjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:portable: node scripts/ensure-duckdb-bindings.cjs && node scripts/clean-build-headroom.cjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win portable && node scripts/verify-portable.cjs
scripts.dist:zip: node scripts/ensure-duckdb-bindings.cjs && node scripts/clean-build-headroom.cjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win dir && node scripts/zip-portable-folder.cjs
